name: Vanthorpe Meridian Wristband Comm MK-1
description: Slim brushed-titanium cuff, 22mm wide, with a recessed micro-display across the outer face that reads clean biometric data, message queues, and calendar blocks in cool white text. The inner band is soft medical-grade polymer, shaped to seat flush against augmented or unaugmented wrists alike. Available in satin titanium or matte carbon. Understated enough for a board meeting, readable enough for a factory floor supervisor who got promoted.
functionality: Biometric monitoring, encrypted message relay, calendar and transit sync, NFC payment chip, 72-hour battery life. BCI-readable with standard neural port handshake. Haptic alert pulse.
what_it_says: Competent, connected, and careful about how much they show — this person lives and dies by their schedule.
story_hooks: The MK-1 firmware has a known exploit that lets a nearby device silently mirror its message queue — Vanthorpe issued a patch, but millions of units were never updated.
A dead Tier 3 auditor is found with her MK-1 wiped clean — but the wipe timestamp is three hours after her estimated time of death.
Someone is paying Φ2,000 cash for specific MK-1 serial number ranges, no questions asked.

physical_description.visual_profile: A minimalist wrist cuff that reads as executive-grade tech without ostentation. Sits flush against the wrist with a subtle curved profile. The recessed display creates a shallow depression across the outer face, catching light in a way that feels intentional rather than flashy.
physical_description.fit: Precision-engineered to seat flush on both augmented and unaugmented wrists. Compression-fit but not restrictive—designed for all-day wear without pressure points. The inner polymer band conforms slightly to wrist geometry.
physical_description.primary_material: Brushed titanium or matte carbon alloy casing; soft medical-grade silicone polymer inner band. Display integrated flush beneath a sapphire-composite lens.
physical_description.texture: Brushed metal exterior with a satin or matte finish that resists fingerprints. Inner band is soft, slightly tacky polymer—medical-grade and sweat-resistant. The display face is smooth and recessed, creating subtle tactile distinction.
physical_description.color_scheme: Satin titanium (cool silver-gray with brushed micro-scratches) or matte carbon (deep charcoal with faint metallic undertone). Display text in cool white or pale cyan, biometric indicators in soft accent colors (green for nominal, amber for caution).
physical_description.closures: Friction-fit band closure with magnetic micro-locks on the inner seam—silent, seamless, no visible fasteners.
distinctive_features: Recessed micro-display across outer face with always-on biometric readout
Flat, understated aesthetic despite embedded tech
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 1–2. The Vanthorpe name carries corpo prestige; the price point is accessible to mid-tier management but signals wealth and access.
physical_description.cultural_context: Worn by executives, augmented medical professionals, middle-management corpo workers. The wearer is networked, organized, and trusted with real-time data. Clean enough for a board meeting; functional enough for field supervision.
physical_description.condition_typical: Pristine out of the box, ages beautifully with micro-scratches in the brushed finish that only enhance the heirloom-tech aesthetic. Minor polymer wear on the inner band after years of daily use, but structurally sound.
